description: Inspect child agents owned by this parent and receive at most one pending update: an unread child report or a terminal result, which this call collects into the task DAG and workspace. With timeoutMs omitted or zero it returns an immediate snapshot; a positive timeoutMs blocks until an update arrives or the timeout elapses.

propertyDescriptions.agentIds: Optional children to observe. Omit to observe every child owned by this parent.
propertyDescriptions.timeoutMs: Optional bounded time to wait for an update. Omit or use zero for an immediate snapshot.

guidance: A child report does not complete or collect the child: keep observing with a positive timeoutMs until its terminal result is collected.
